recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, multi-layered composition featuring a central portrait obscured by a chaotic web of geometric lines and overlapping hand gestures. The style utilizes a distinct 3D anaglyph color separation effect combined with a coarse mechanical halftone texture, creating a sense of vibrating movement and digital-analog hybridity.
coreVisualRelationships: Interplay between organic hand shapes and rigid geometric vectors
Color-shifted duplication creating a sense of motion blur
Aggressive diagonal lines cutting through a central focal point
Textural contrast between smooth color gradients and grainy halftone dots
coreInvariants: Cyan and red color offset (anaglyph effect)
Coarse dot-matrix or halftone screen texture
Dense network of intersecting thin white and colored lines
Multiple overlapping exposures of the same subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central human figure, primarily focused on the face and multiple hands, filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject, visible through the gaps in the hands and lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A radial explosion of lines leads the eye from the center outward, while the diagonal text in the corners creates a counter-balance.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with visual information and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated cyan and muted red creating a chromatic aberration effect.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/cream background and bright white highlights in the line work.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep navy blue used for shadows and heavy halftone areas.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast; colors feel like aged print rather than digital neon.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cyan, red, navy, and cream
Avoid pure blacks or vibrant primary greens

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed, geometric sans-serif and heavy block display types.
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top right feature a horizontal scan-line texture
Corner text is set on a 45-degree diagonal band

composition.overlap: Placed on a white diagonal banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact display face paired with a functional, clean sans-serif for technical details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed display feel of the primary text.
Provides the necessary clean, mid-century industrial look for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photomontage of a person's face and multiple hands in motion. Apply a heavy halftone dot texture and a red/cyan anaglyph color shift. Overlay a dense web of thin, intersecting white and blue diagonal lines. The overall look should resemble a 1980s printed magazine page.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed uppercase text in the top right with a horizontal line texture. Add a white diagonal banner in the top left corner with clean, spaced-out cyan sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture visible across the entire image?
Do the cyan and red color shifts create a sense of 3D depth or motion?
Are the geometric lines sharp and distinct from the textured background?
Is the corner text correctly angled at 45 degrees?

adjustableVariables: Density of the geometric line web
Intensity of the red/cyan color offset
Subject matter of the central photomontage
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Unique logos or brand marks in the bottom left
Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Sense of kinetic energy and vibration

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present.
Check that the halftone pattern does not create unwanted moiré.
Verify the text feels integrated into the print texture.
Confirm the composition feels 'busy' but intentional.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject] with [Halftone Texture] + [Anaglyph Color Shift] + [Geometric Line Overlay] + [Diagonal Corner Typography].
